notes.title: Two-year anniversary of Giraffe and Annika with an Art Book and Comic Book!
notes.content:
Dear Users,

It's been two years since the release of Giraffe and Annika on Steam!
And to celebrate, we are proud to announce the release of an exclusive Art Book and Comic Book!
Be sure to also purchase the game at 60% off for one whole week with the two-year anniversary sale! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35716925/d64e966587b0dab83b08e45a939418434696bbd8.png

This is an art book containing illustrations from Giraffe and Annika, character settings, background settings, design materials, bonus illustrations, all Meowsterpieces from the game, unused settings and more!

This is a comic book containing all of the comic scenes, alternate scenes, rejected scenes, and making-of scenes up through the ending of Giraffe and Annika.

Both books are full of behind-the-scenes never before seen content from the developers that you can only find exclusively here on Steam.

Grab your copies at 10% off with the two-year anniversary sale!

It's time to learn more about the heartwarming world of Giraffe and Annika! Be sure to grab your game and copies of the Art and Comic Book today!

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
Today we have a little update for everyone looking forward to Giraffe And Annika!

Update Contents
-Full-screen mode has been fixed, and tearing no longer occurs
-Rail car difficulty level adjusted
 *Flame damage reduced; R stick no longer controls camera; camera movement now reflects analog input to make aiming easier
-Respawn points added to the back half of Dungeon 5; difficulty level adjusted
-Game will now only detect keyboard or gamepad when starting the game; toggle settings function added
-Screen showing controls for several seconds when starting the game and entering dungeons added
-Floating/sinking keyboard controls switched from "Shift" to "Q" and "E" while in water
-Changed Christmas achievement explanatory text
-Fixed several bugs and errors that were preventing progress

notes.title: Giraffe & Annika - Spica Island Tourist Guide Part 2: The Spook Gallery
notes.content:
Greetings from PLAYISM.

Giraffe And Annika - a 3D action-adventure (with a bit of rhythm added for good measure) game set on the tiny, beautiful Spica Island is almost here! Today, we'd like to introduce you to the Spook Gallery in Part 2 of our Spica Island Tourist Guide.

Hand over the cat pictures you've collected to the Ghost Baron and they'll be put on display in the Gallery! You can also rack up points to receive some super luxurious prizes! The Ghost Baron is straight-up obsessed with cat-themed merchandise, so the Gallery is lousy with cats - both inside and out!😺
There's also a photo stand-in right out in front of the Spook Gallery, so be sure to go check it out and get your picture taken!

The game's full release is almost upon us, so in the meantime keep on daydreaming of all the adventures you're gonna enjoy on the stunning and mysterious Spica Island!

notes.title: Giraffe & Annika - Spica Island Tourist Guide Part 1: The Observatory
notes.content:
Greetings from PLAYISM,

The release date for Giraffe and Annika, February 18th, is fast approaching. This title is a 3D action adventure and rhythm game set on the beautiful little Spica Island. 
In preparation for release, we would like to inform everyone of the island’s delights in the form of a Spica Island Tourist Guide, which we plan to bring to you over several updates.

In this first installment we will be talking about the Spica Island Observatory. A boy named Thomas resides in the observatory and spends his nights observing the cosmos. The observatory features an impressive telescope and when night falls on the island the roof opens up to reveal it.

[previewyoutube=7dt8tQ2v6dw;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoy exploring the wonders of Spica Island, and don’t forget to mark February 18th on your calendars!
